body: Major release: expense lists become ledgers with expense, income and transfer entries, and the client/server interface gets a protocol version (3), which is why this is 3.0.0. Includes the balance colours, the About text fix and the protocol-header hardening. Every device must be updated together with the server: an older app is turned away with client_outdated until it is. Supersedes 2.2.0.
title: Release 3.0.0
